newsitem.title: USA: U.S. court dismisses appeal in suit vs Crane.
newsitem.headline: U.S. court dismisses appeal in suit vs Crane.

text.p: A U.S. court has dismissed an appeal filed by a plaintiff that had brought a false claims lawsuit against Crane Co, the company said Tuesday.
The United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit issued an opinion affirming the earlier dismissal of the case by a district court, it said in a statement.
"Both opinions have confirmed our position that the allegations were baseless and the False Claims Act did not apply," it said.
A company official said a private plaintiff had filed the suit against the company on behalf of the U.S. government regarding the termination of a pension plan of former subsidiary CF&I Steel Corp.
The government terminated the plan after the former subsidiary went bankrupt.
In his suit, Stanley Rabushka alleged that Crane spun off the subsidiary in 1985 because it knew CF&I was in financial trouble.
Crane makes engineered industrial products and distributes doors, windows and millwork.
